driveSettings.title: Fileship drive
driveSettings.description: Your files and folders in File Explorer. Files download when you open them.
driveSettings.locationDescription: Moving the drive takes your synced files out of the old folder.

tips.onlineDescription: They take no space until you open them.
tips.offlineDescription: Right click and choose "Always keep on this device", or "Free up space" to download them again later.
tips.editsDescription: Saving a changed file uploads it again, so its link changes.
tips.deleteDescription: Files you move to the Recycle Bin go to the Fileship trash. When Windows deletes a file for good, with Shift + Delete or because it was online only, it is deleted from Fileship too.
